messages:
Alex P.: Quick check — locking the launch gate for model-serving v2. We need a finalization sync to walk canary/rollback, final RFC callouts, and cut readiness. Proposed times: Thu Mar 10 10:00am PT or Fri Mar 11 2:00pm PT. Which works? Also drafting agenda below. Please RSVP and call out any blockers.

Sophia L.: I can do Thu 10am. Add Prod QA and infra owners. :thumbsup:

Mike K.: Out Thu morning, so Fri 2pm works for me. Also need a last-minute CR pass on the runtime changes — pinging Jen for CR status.

Jen R.: CRs are in, two small comments open. CI needs to finish but I expect merge before EOD. I can join Fri or Thu afternoon if we shift.

Sam N.: SRE on Fri 2pm. Recommend we include 'rollback thresholds' and 'traffic split plan' on the agenda so oncall knows the triggers.

Alex P.: Good call. Draft agenda (short):
```
1) Roll call & stake owners (5m)
2) RFC highlights + open design items (5m) — Jen
3) Canary plan & traffic split (10m) — Sam
4) Rollback thresholds & runbooks (10m) — SRE
5) Cut readiness checklist & smoke tests (10m) — QA
6) Post-cut monitoring + escalation (5m)
```
Please bring one slide for risks. Also plan to run `scripts/smoke_test.sh` post-cut (QA owns it).

deploy-bot: heads up — deploy freeze starts Fri Mar 11 12:00 PDT. See https://intranet.redwood/ops/deploy-freeze :warning:

Sophia L.: If freeze starts Fri noon, Fri 2pm is really tight for a launch. Thu 10am looks safer to ensure time for rollback and final fixes.

Mike K.: Agreed, Thu 10am preferred. Can infra make that? @Tariq M.

Tariq M.: I can do Thu 10am. Sending calendar invite now.

Alex P.: Great — current RSVP: Alex, Sophia, Jen, Sam, Mike, Tariq, Rachel (PM), Lena (Legal), deploy-bot. Rachel confirmed availability for Thu 10am.

Rachel P.: Confirmed. I'll cover stakeholder comms and post-cut customer notices.

Lena G.: I can join for the data-retention/PII callouts. No major legal blockers expected but will confirm.

Jen R.: I'll prepare the RFC 2-min summary and the CR checklist. If CI isn't green by Wed EOD I'll post a blocker here.

Alex P.: Thanks all. Final asks before Thu: post one-line blockers in this thread, attach your slide to the calendar event, and if you can't make it, nominate an alternate. See you Thu 10am PT. :rocket:
